newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NSW TCorp ahead on offshore debt sale target.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NSW TCorp ahead on offshore debt sale target.

text.p: New South Wales Treasury Corp (TCorp) said on Tuesday its gross issuance of offshore debt is well ahead of its A$2.0 billion target for the 1996/97 fiscal year ending June30.

This has been a deliberate strategy given that TCorp has continued to be reasonably active in repurchasing seasoned issues from the Japanese retail sector, TCorp said in its six month financial update to December 1996.
TCorp's total funding programme for 1996/97 remains at an A$4.0 billion for the fiscal year, as announced at the time of the May 1996 budget.
This level of borrowing was consistent with the projected small budget surplus and the funding of maturing debt totalling A$4.2 billion for the financial year.
Total debt issued offshore amounted to A$1.644 billion in the six months to December.

In the December quarter, TCorp continued to focus on the Japanese retail sector with A$812 million of funds raised through issuance into the Japanese market comprising two dual currency issues and two straight Australian dollar issues.
It also issued a A$100 million Eurobond.

On the domestic front, TCorp said it is regularly active in the marketplace in terms of purchasing and issuing benchmark bonds in its strategy to have a minimum of A$12.0 billion of outstanding debt over this financial year and next.
As at December 1996, TCorp domestic benchmark bonds on issue totalled A$12.825 billion, up marginally from A$12.726 billion at the end of September and A$12.654 billion at the end of June 1996.
